The G5Q-1A4-EL2-HA is a miniature general-purpose power PCB relay manufactured by Omron (now branded through Aratas / Omron Electronic Components).

Key Specifications & Features

• Relay Type: Miniature electromagnetic PCB power relay (General Purpose)
• Contact Configuration: SPST-NO (1 Form A)
• Contact Material: AgSnIn (Silver-tin-indium)
• Switching / Rated Current: 10 A
• Inrush Load Capacity (-EL2 type): Handles inrush currents up to 40 A for 100 microseconds (break current up to 1 A)
• Sealing: Sealed construction
• Coil Voltage Options: Available in standard DC coil variants (such as 5 VDC, 12 VDC, and 24 VDC)
• Body Dimensions: Approx. 20.3 × 10.3 × 15.8 mm
